     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluingDiagramIso

     9	/-!
    10	# The right leg of the finite-stage Picard gluing comparison
    11	
    12	The overlap comparison in `Pic0FiniteStageGluingDiagramIso` respects the second
    13	multispan leg as well as the first.  This is the remaining local naturality
    14	equation needed to assemble the chart and overlap comparisons into a natural
    15	isomorphism of gluing diagrams.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    34	
    35	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    36	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    37	@[reassoc]
    38	theorem rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap_fst
    39	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    40	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    41	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    42	    rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap C P U V ≫
    43	        pullback.fst
    44	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    45	            (algebraMap P.N.1
    46	              (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    47	                C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N V))))
    48	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) =
    49	      pullback.fst
    50	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    51	            (algebraMap P.N.1
    52	              (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    53	                C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
    54	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) ≫
    55	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    56	          (rightRestrictionBaseChangeAlgHom C P U V).toRingHom) := by
    57	  exact affineBaseChangeMap_fst P.N.1 k
    58	    (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    59	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N V)
    60	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    61	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)
    62	    (rightRestrictionBaseChangeAlgHom C P U V)
    63	
    64	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    65	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    66	@[reassoc]
    67	theorem rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap_snd
    68	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    69	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    70	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    71	    rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap C P U V ≫
    72	        pullback.snd
    73	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    74	            (algebraMap P.N.1
    75	              (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    76	                C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N V))))
    77	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) =
    78	      pullback.snd
    79	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    80	          (algebraMap P.N.1
    81	            (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    82	              C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V))))
    83	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k))) := by
    84	  exact affineBaseChangeMap_snd P.N.1 k
    85	    (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
    86	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N V)
    87	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapBaseChangeRing
    88	      C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N U V)
    89	    (rightRestrictionBaseChangeAlgHom C P U V)
    90	
    91	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    92	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    93	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    94	theorem gluingOverlapIso_pre_snd
    95	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    96	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
    97	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    98	    ((Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
    99	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).t U V ≫
   100	        (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   101	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).f V U) ≫
   102	        (pullback.congrHom (glueData_ι_gluedMap C P V) rfl).hom =
   103	      (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V).hom ≫
   104	        (pullback.congrHom
   105	          (glueData_f_comp_inclusion_comp_gluedMap C P U V) rfl).hom ≫
   106	        rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap C P U V := by
   107	  apply pullback.hom_ext
   108	    (f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   109	      (algebraMap P.N.1
   110	        (Pic0FiniteStageChartBaseChangeRing
   111	          C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.M P.N V))))
   112	    (g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))
   113	  · simp only [Category.assoc]
   114	    refine Eq.trans
   115	      (congrArg
   116	        (fun q =>
   117	          ((Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   118	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).t U V ≫
   119	              (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   120	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).f V U) ≫ q)
   121	        (pullback_congrHom_hom_fst (glueData_ι_gluedMap C P V) rfl)) ?_
   122	    refine Eq.trans ?_
   123	      (congrArg
   124	        (fun q =>
   125	          (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V).hom ≫
   126	            (pullback.congrHom
   127	              (glueData_f_comp_inclusion_comp_gluedMap C P U V) rfl).hom ≫ q)
   128	        (rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap_fst (C := C) P U V)).symm
   129	    refine Eq.trans ?_
   130	      (congrArg
   131	        (fun q => (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V).hom ≫ q)
   132	        (pullback_congrHom_hom_fst_assoc
   133	          (glueData_f_comp_inclusion_comp_gluedMap C P U V) rfl
   134	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   135	            (rightRestrictionBaseChangeAlgHom C P U V).toRingHom)))).symm
   136	    exact (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso_hom_comp_fst_comp_t_f C P U V).symm
   137	  · simp only [Category.assoc]
   138	    refine Eq.trans
   139	      (congrArg
   140	        (fun q =>
   141	          ((Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   142	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).t U V ≫
   143	              (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   144	                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).f V U) ≫ q)
   145	        (pullback_congrHom_hom_snd (glueData_ι_gluedMap C P V) rfl)) ?_
   146	    refine Eq.trans ?_
   147	      (congrArg
   148	        (fun q =>
   149	          (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V).hom ≫
   150	            (pullback.congrHom
   151	              (glueData_f_comp_inclusion_comp_gluedMap C P U V) rfl).hom ≫ q)
   152	        (rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap_snd (C := C) P U V)).symm
   153	    refine Eq.trans ?_
   154	      (congrArg
   155	        (fun q => (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso C P U V).hom ≫ q)
   156	        (pullback_congrHom_hom_snd
   157	          (glueData_f_comp_inclusion_comp_gluedMap C P U V) rfl)).symm
   158	    exact (gluingOverlapFlatteningIso_hom_comp_snd C P U V).symm
   159	
   160	/-- The spectrum of the exact right restriction, followed by the right chart's
   161	affine identification, is the affine-overlap identification. -/
   162	theorem exactRightRestrictionAlgHom_fromSpec
   163	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   164	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   165	        (exactRightRestrictionAlgHom C U V).toRingHom) ≫
   166	        V.1.2.fromSpec =
   167	      (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.fromSpec := by
   168	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   169	      (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V).toRingHom) ≫
   170	      V.1.2.fromSpec = _
   171	  change Spec.map
   172	      ((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.presheaf.map
   173	        (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V)).op) ≫
   174	      V.1.2.fromSpec = _
   175	  exact V.1.2.map_fromSpec (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2
   176	    (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V)).op
   177	
   178	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   179	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
   180	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   181	/-- The overlap comparison respects the right multispan projection. -/
   182	theorem gluingOverlapIso_snd
   183	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   184	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   185	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   186	    ((Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   187	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).t U V ≫
   188	        (Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
   189	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))).f V U) ≫
   190	        (gluingChartIso C P V).hom =
   191	      (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
   192	        ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
   193	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U) := by
   194	  have chart_fac :
   195	      (chartBaseChangeIso C P V).hom ≫ V.1.1.ι =
   196	        (chartRingBaseChangeIso C P V).hom ≫ V.1.2.fromSpec := by
   197	    calc
   198	      _ = (chartRingBaseChangeIso C P V).hom ≫
   199	          (V.1.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ V.1.1.ι) := by
   200	        simp only [chartBaseChangeIso, chartRingBaseChangeIso,
   201	          chartFinalBaseChangeEquiv, affineBaseChangeIso, Iso.trans_hom,
   202	          Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
   203	      _ = _ := congrArg (fun q => (chartRingBaseChangeIso C P V).hom ≫ q)
   204	        V.1.2.isoSpec_inv_ι
   205	  have overlap_fac :
   206	      (overlapBaseChangeIso C P U V).hom ≫
   207	          (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1.ι =
   208	      (overlapRingBaseChangeIso C P U V).hom ≫
   209	          (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.fromSpec := by
   210	    calc
   211	      _ = (overlapRingBaseChangeIso C P U V).hom ≫
   212	          ((pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.isoSpec.inv ≫
   213	            (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).1.ι) := by
   214	        simp only [overlapBaseChangeIso, overlapRingBaseChangeIso,
   215	          overlapFinalBaseChangeEquiv, affineBaseChangeIso, Iso.trans_hom,
   216	          Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
   217	      _ = _ := congrArg
   218	        (fun q => (overlapRingBaseChangeIso C P U V).hom ≫ q)
   219	        (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.isoSpec_inv_ι
   220	  apply (cancel_mono V.1.1.ι).1
   221	  simp only [gluingChartIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
   222	  rw [chart_fac]
   223	  rw [reassoc_of% gluingOverlapIso_pre_snd C P U V]
   224	  simp only [gluingOverlapIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
   225	  rw [← Category.assoc (rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap C P U V)]
   226	  rw [rightRestrictionBaseChangeMap_naturality C P U V]
   227	  rw [Category.assoc (overlapRingBaseChangeIso C P U V).hom]
   228	  rw [exactRightRestrictionAlgHom_fromSpec C U V]
   229	  simp only [pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData, Scheme.Cover.gluedCover_f,
   230	    Scheme.Cover.gluedCover_t, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]
   231	  rw [IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_snd_assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
   232	  rw [overlap_fac]
   233	
   234	end Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
   235	
   236	end
   237	
   238	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluingOverlapIsoSnd
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The global finite-stage Picard gluing comparison
    10	
    11	The chart and overlap comparisons identify the two multicoequalizer diagrams, hence
    12	their glued schemes.  Composing this global comparison with compatibility of gluing
    13	and base change identifies the scalar extension of the finite-stage model with the
    14	exact separably closed Picard representer.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    28	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    29	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    30	
    31	namespace Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage
    32	
    33	private noncomputable abbrev baseChangedGlueData
    34	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    35	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) : Scheme.GlueData :=
    36	  Scheme.Pullback.gluing P.glueData.openCover P.gluedMap
    37	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.N.1 k)))
    38	
    39	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    40	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    41	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    42	private noncomputable def gluingGluedHom
    43	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    44	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
    45	    (baseChangedGlueData C P).glued ⟶
    46	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).glued := by
    47	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
    48	  · intro U
    49	    exact (gluingChartIso C P U).hom ≫
    50	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U
    51	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
    52	    change
    53	      (baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V ≫
    54	          ((gluingChartIso C P U).hom ≫
    55	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U) =
    56	        ((baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
    57	            (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U) ≫
    58	          ((gluingChartIso C P V).hom ≫
    59	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι V)
    60	    calc
    61	      _ = ((baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V ≫
    62	            (gluingChartIso C P U).hom) ≫
    63	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U :=
    64	        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    65	      _ = ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
    66	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f U V) ≫
    67	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U :=
    68	        congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U)
    69	          (gluingOverlapIso_fst C P U V)
    70	      _ = (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
    71	          ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f U V ≫
    72	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U) :=
    73	        Category.assoc _ _ _
    74	      _ = (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
    75	          ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
    76	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U ≫
    77	              (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι V) :=
    78	        congrArg (fun q => (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫ q)
    79	          ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).glue_condition U V).symm
    80	      _ = ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
    81	            ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
    82	              (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U)) ≫
    83	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι V := by
    84	        simp only [Category.assoc]
    85	      _ = (((baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
    86	              (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U) ≫
    87	            (gluingChartIso C P V).hom) ≫
    88	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι V :=
    89	        congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι V)
    90	          (gluingOverlapIso_snd C P U V).symm
    91	      _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _

    93	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    94	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    95	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    96	@[reassoc]
    97	private theorem gluingGluedHom_ι
    98	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
    99	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   100	    (U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   101	    (baseChangedGlueData C P).ι U ≫ gluingGluedHom C P =
   102	      (gluingChartIso C P U).hom ≫
   103	        (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).ι U := by
   104	  unfold gluingGluedHom
   105	  exact Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _
   106	
   107	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   108	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
   109	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   110	private theorem gluingOverlapIso_inv_fst
   111	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   112	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   113	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   114	    (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f U V ≫
   115	        (gluingChartIso C P U).inv =
   116	      (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).inv ≫
   117	        (baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V := by
   118	  apply (cancel_epi (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom).1
   119	  calc
   120	    _ = ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
   121	          (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f U V) ≫
   122	        (gluingChartIso C P U).inv :=
   123	      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
   124	    _ = (((baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V ≫
   125	          (gluingChartIso C P U).hom)) ≫
   126	        (gluingChartIso C P U).inv :=
   127	      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (gluingChartIso C P U).inv)
   128	        (gluingOverlapIso_fst C P U V).symm
   129	    _ = (baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V := by simp
   130	    _ = (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
   131	        ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).inv ≫
   132	          (baseChangedGlueData C P).f U V) := by simp

   137	private theorem gluingOverlapIso_inv_snd
   138	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   139	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F)
   140	    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   141	    ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
   142	        (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U) ≫
   143	      (gluingChartIso C P V).inv =
   144	    (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).inv ≫
   145	      ((baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
   146	        (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U) := by
   147	  apply (cancel_epi (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom).1
   148	  calc
   149	    _ = ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
   150	          ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
   151	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U)) ≫
   152	        (gluingChartIso C P V).inv :=
   153	      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
   154	    _ = (((baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
   155	            (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U) ≫
   156	          (gluingChartIso C P V).hom) ≫
   157	        (gluingChartIso C P V).inv :=
   158	      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (gluingChartIso C P V).inv)
   159	        (gluingOverlapIso_snd C P U V).symm
   160	    _ = (baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
   161	        (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U := by simp
   162	    _ = (gluingOverlapIso C P U V).hom ≫
   163	        ((gluingOverlapIso C P U V).inv ≫
   164	          ((baseChangedGlueData C P).t U V ≫
   165	            (baseChangedGlueData C P).f V U)) := by simp

   167	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   168	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
   169	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   170	private noncomputable def gluingGluedInv
   171	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]
   172	    (P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage C F) :
   173	    (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).glued ⟶
   174	      (baseChangedGlueData C P).glued := by
   175	  fapply Multicoequalizer.desc
   176	  · intro U
   177	    exact (gluingChartIso C P U).inv ≫
   178	      (baseChangedGlueData C P).ι U
   179	  · rintro ⟨U, V⟩
   180	    change
   181	      (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f U V ≫
   182	          ((gluingChartIso C P U).inv ≫
   183	            (baseChangedGlueData C P).ι U) =
   184	        ((pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).t U V ≫
   185	            (pic0SepClosedAtlasGlueData C).f V U) ≫
   186	          ((gluingChartIso C P V).inv ≫

## Required proof loop

Load this skill before editing a Lean file. Before the first proof edit, invoke
at least one Lean LSP MCP query for the target (`lean_diagnostic_messages` or
`lean_goal`). After every proof edit, invoke diagnostics or the goal query again
before starting another tactic attempt. Use `lean_multi_attempt`, hover, and
search to investigate candidates instead of repeatedly launching a build.

Do not start iterative proof work with `lake build`: it is a slow, final-boundary
check. Use LSP for the edit loop and reserve `lake build` for the final session
validation (or when a kernel check is specifically needed). When LSP is
unavailable or crashes, record that in the report and use the narrowest fallback,
usually `lake env lean <file>` or a single module, rather than silently skipping
the check.

LSP is sufficient between edits and between separate obligations. Do not run a
module build after every proof or repeat a narrow build immediately before a
configured final build that covers the same files. At the final boundary, run
the configured build once and wait for it. Add an earlier narrow kernel check
only when LSP failed, the change crosses an interface LSP cannot validate, or a
specific elaboration/kernel question must be settled before continuing.

- During proof writing, prefer the Lean LSP MCP server for fast local feedback:
  inspect goals/diagnostics at the edited location before running a full build.
  This is the fastest loop for filling proofs.
- Treat LSP feedback as interactive guidance, not final verification. The
  faithful check is Lean's kernel via the project build: run the configured
  build command, `lake build <Module>`, or `lake env lean <file>` from the
  project root.
- Prefer the project's configured build command when validating a task. Otherwise
  use the narrowest faithful check that covers the changed file/module.
- Re-run after each change and repair failures you introduce.
- Read errors top-down — the first error often causes the cascade. For each,
  note the `file:line`, expected vs actual type, and remaining goal.
- A `sorry` left in place is an open obligation, not a success. Do not hide a
  hard obligation behind a new `sorry` unless a hint explicitly allows it.

## Fast LSP proving loop

The `lean-lsp` MCP server gives sub-second feedback — far faster than a build
(10–30s+). Drive proofs with it, then confirm with the kernel. Key tools:

- `lean_goal(file, line)` — the proof state at a line. Call before writing any
  tactic and after each one. Empty `goals_after` = that step closes the goal.
- `lean_diagnostic_messages(file)` — instant errors/warnings after every edit
  (`[]` = no errors, but *not* proof-complete — confirm with `lean_goal`).
- `lean_multi_attempt(file, line, snippets=[...])` — test 3–5 **single-line,
  indented** candidate tactics at once and see exactly which close the goal and
  why the others fail. The highest-leverage tool for filling a `sorry`.
- `lean_hover_info(file, line, col)` — type/signature/docs at an identifier
  (point at the first char). `lean_file_outline(file)` — declarations + line
  numbers without reading the whole file. `lean_run_code("#eval …")` — quick
  standalone `#check`/`#eval`/`#print`.

Core loop: `lean_goal` (what to prove) → search a premise (see the `leansearch`
skill: `lean_local_search` / `lean_leansearch`) → `lean_multi_attempt` (test
candidates) → edit with the winner → `lean_diagnostic_messages` (confirm) →
kernel-check the module at the end.

## Heavy builds — actually wait for them

Read the WHOLE build output, not just pass/fail: warnings (unused variables,
deprecations, `sorry` notices, unexpected recompiles) are actionable — fix the
ones your change introduced, and record pre-existing/toolchain ones as memory
or an inbox issue rather than scrolling past (see the `horizon` skill,
"Warnings are work").

A cold `lake build` (or one that recompiles Mathlib) can take many minutes. The
most common way a session ends on a wrong conclusion is **not waiting for the
build to finish**:

- Do **not** assume you will be "automatically notified" or "re-invoked" when a
  background build completes — whether that happens depends entirely on the
  mechanism you used. If unsure, run the build in the **foreground** and block on
  it until it exits, then read the exit code.
- If you run it in the background, you MUST actively wait: poll its status/output
  until there is a definitive exit code (a monitor / until-loop, re-reading the
  log), and only then conclude. A background job you started but walked away from
  is *not* done.
- Scope the build to the narrowest faithful check (`lake build <Module>` or
  `lake env lean <file>`) to keep the wait short; reserve the full project build

- Never write your final report — or `complete` an inbox item, or mark a task

  engine cannot wait long enough, say so explicitly under `## Issues` and leave

  closing comment with the exact check command, result, relevant files, and any
  caveat. If a task has `roadmap_refs`, make sure the linked roadmap items end
  with a consistent status and their own sync/closing comment.

## When the LSP dies on big import files

The Lean LSP loads the full environment for the file you open. On a file whose
imports pull in most of Mathlib (a broad `import Mathlib` umbrella, or a module
that transitively imports one), that environment is huge and the LSP server can
run out of memory or time out and die. This is an LSP limitation, **not** a
proof error:

- Do not treat an LSP crash/timeout on such a file as a failure of your proof.
  Fall back to the kernel check: `lake build <Module>` or `lake env lean <file>`,
  which verifies faithfully without holding the whole environment interactively.
- Prefer opening the **narrowest** module in the LSP. Avoid pointing the LSP at
  umbrella/`import Mathlib`-style files just to get feedback; edit and inspect
  the specific module you are proving in instead.
- If the LSP has crashed, restart it (or just proceed with `lake build`) rather
  than repeatedly reopening the same giant file and getting the same crash.

`informal/w4-datj-worksheet.md` §1.1/§0.9 pins the interface DAT-J consumes from DAT-G as
**DJ-IN** = `PicRepDatum k k C`, and its §1.1 producer target reads

```
jacobianData C : JacobianData C where
  J := (datGDatum C).J ; rep := (datGDatum C).rep
  locallyOfFiniteType := (datGDatum C).lft ; quasiCompact := quasiCompact_jacobian C
```

with the note that *"every symbol on the RHS except `datGDatum` (DAT-G) and
`quasiCompact_jacobian` (DJ-1) is landed"* and that the `rep :=` line needs **no adapter**
because the two field types are definitionally equal (`Picard/PicRepDatum.lean`, the module's
defeq smoke test).

The lightweight packaging and its definitional compatibility lemmas live in
`Picard/JacobianDataHandoff.lean`.  Keeping them there prevents the eventual challenge-field
producer from importing the Abel-surjectivity and Riemann--Roch dependency cone.

The content is exactly the interface, so it is short by design — but it is not nothing:
writing it is what turns "DAT-G produces a datum over `k'`, and separately DAT-J wants one
over `k`" into a single arrow, and it is what makes the remaining DAT-J debt *visibly* two
statements (the DAT-G descent, and the quasi-compactness) rather than an unspecified
assembly.

    35	
    36	/-- A gluing datum consists of
    37	1. An index type `J`
    38	2. An object `U i` for each `i : J`.
    39	3. An object `V i j` for each `i j : J`.
    40	4. A monomorphism `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` for each `i j : J`.
    41	5. A transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` for each `i j : J`.
    42	
    43	such that
    44	6. `f i i` is an isomorphism.
    45	7. `t i i` is the identity.
    46	8. The pullback for `f i j` and `f i k` exists.
    47	9. `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` via some
    48	    `t' : V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V j k ×[U j] V j i`.
    49	10. `t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _`.
    50	-/
    51	structure GlueData where
    52	  /-- The index type `J` of a gluing datum -/
    53	  J : Type v
    54	  /-- For each `i : J`, an object `U i` -/
    55	  U : J → C
    56	  /-- For each `i j : J`, an object `V i j` -/
    57	  V : J × J → C
    58	  /-- For each `i j : J`, a monomorphism `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` -/
    59	  f : ∀ i j, V (i, j) ⟶ U i
    60	  f_mono : ∀ i j, Mono (f i j) := by infer_instance
    61	  f_hasPullback : ∀ i j k, HasPullback (f i j) (f i k) := by infer_instance
    62	  f_id : ∀ i, IsIso (f i i) := by infer_instance
    63	  /-- For each `i j : J`, a transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` -/
    64	  t : ∀ i j, V (i, j) ⟶ V (j, i)
    65	  t_id : ∀ i, t i i = 𝟙 _
    66	  /-- The morphism via which `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through
    67	  `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` -/
    68	  t' : ∀ i j k, pullback (f i j) (f i k) ⟶ pullback (f j k) (f j i)
    69	  t_fac : ∀ i j k, t' i j k ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ t i j
    70	  cocycle : ∀ i j k, t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _

/-!
# Picard representability as scheme descent data

This module packages the canonical tensor-overlap isomorphism of a local Picard
representative as honest descent data for the pullback pseudofunctor of schemes.
-/

/-- For the pullback pseudofunctor of over categories, `pullHom` is the literal
three-factor pullback comparison. -/
lemma pullHom_eq_pullbackFaceIsoOfEq_hom
    {D : Type u} [Category.{v, u} D] [HasPullbacks D]
    {V W X : D} (r₀ r₁ : V ⟶ X) (q : V ⟶ W) (p₀ p₁ : W ⟶ X)
    (J : Over X) (h₀ : r₀ = q ≫ p₀) (h₁ : r₁ = q ≫ p₁)
    (i : (Over.pullback p₀).obj J ≅ (Over.pullback p₁).obj J) :
    pullHom (F := Over.pullbackPseudofunctor (C := D)) i.hom q r₀ r₁ h₀.symm h₁.symm =

        r₀ r₁ q p₀ p₁ h₀ h₁ i).hom := by

  subst r₁

# The semilinear Galois action on a Picard-zero representative

For an arbitrary extension `L/k`, a `k`-algebra automorphism of `L` twists the
structure map of every `L`-test.  Restricting that test back to `k` forgets the
twist.  Conjugating this observation by `pic0ThetaType` gives an action on the
Picard-zero functor over `L`; representability will transport it to the
representing scheme.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]

/-- The structure morphism of the field-extension test functor. -/
noncomputable abbrev pic0GaloisBaseMap :
    Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))

/-- Restriction of an `L`-test to a `k`-test. -/
noncomputable abbrev pic0GaloisRestrictTest :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
  Over.map (pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L))

/-- Every `k`-algebra automorphism of `L` is invisible after composing with
`Spec L ⟶ Spec k`. -/
theorem pic0Galois_baseAut_comp (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[k] L) L gamma).hom ≫
        pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L) =
      pic0GaloisBaseMap (k := k) (L := L) := by
  rw [toSpecAut_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  ext x
  exact gamma⁻¹.commutes x

/-- Twist `L`-tests by a `k`-algebra automorphism of `L`. -/
noncomputable abbrev pic0TwistTestFunctor (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
  Over.map (toSpecAut (L ≃ₐ[k] L) L gamma).hom

/-- Restriction to `k` identifies a twisted `L`-test with the original
restricted test. -/
noncomputable def pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma ⋙
        pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := k) (L := L) ≅
      pic0GaloisRestrictTest (k := k) (L := L) :=
  (Over.mapComp _ _).symm ≪≫
    Over.mapCongr _ _ (pic0Galois_baseAut_comp gamma)

@[simp]
theorem pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso_hom_app_left
    (gamma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))) :
    ((pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso gamma).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [pic0GaloisRestrictTwistIso, Over.mapComp, Over.mapCongr]

/-- A product twist is canonically the corresponding iterated twist. -/
noncomputable def pic0TwistTestFunctorMulIso (gamma tau : L ≃ₐ[k] L) :
    pic0TwistTestFunctor (gamma * tau) ≅
      pic0TwistTestFunctor tau ⋙ pic0TwistTestFunctor gamma :=
  Over.mapCongr _ _ (toSpecAut_mul_hom (L ≃ₐ[k] L) L gamma tau) ≪≫
    Over.mapComp _ _

@[simp]
theorem pic0TwistTestFunctorMulIso_hom_app_left
    (gamma tau : L ≃ₐ[k] L) (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L))) :
    ((pic0TwistTestFunctorMulIso gamma tau).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [pic0TwistTestFunctorMulIso, Over.mapComp, Over.mapCongr]

/-- The identity twist is the identity functor. -/
noncomputable def pic0TwistTestFunctorOneIso :
    pic0TwistTestFunctor (1 : L ≃ₐ[k] L) ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  Over.mapCongr _ _ (by rw [map_one]; rfl) ≪≫ Over.mapId _

For a **separable algebraic** extension `K/k` (the case `K = K_s` a separable closure is the
